definition: the behaviours that say an organisation is somewhere on the trajectory now

settled:
Smaller portions or fewer features at the same price. New fees on what used to be included, or fees rising faster than everything else.

Cheaper inputs, longer waits, fewer staff, shorter hours on support.

Return policies, warranties and refund windows quietly getting worse.

Ads appearing where there were none. My data sold, or turned back on me to sell me something.

Leaving made harder on purpose: my data no longer portable, terms made stickier, connections that only go one way.

Design built against me: dark patterns, friction laid in the way of cancelling, the cheaper option made hard to find.

Any one of those on its own only suggests. Several at once in the same organisation is the finding.

title: The Signs That It Has Started
